nodes.name: StemGeometry
nodes.coreScript:
local segments = 12
local radius = 4
local height = 180

-- Computes a unit face normal for a flat (CCW) triangle directly from its own
-- vertex positions, so lighting is always correct regardless of hand-derived
-- normal math or which way a triangle happens to be wound.
local function faceNormal(a, b, c)
    local e1x, e1y, e1z = b[1] - a[1], b[2] - a[2], b[3] - a[3]
    local e2x, e2y, e2z = c[1] - a[1], c[2] - a[2], c[3] - a[3]
    local nx = e1y * e2z - e1z * e2y
    local ny = e1z * e2x - e1x * e2z
    local nz = e1x * e2y - e1y * e2x
    local len = math.sqrt(nx * nx + ny * ny + nz * nz)
    if len < 1e-8 then
        return {0, 1, 0}
    end
    return {nx / len, ny / len, nz / len}
end

if not STEM_BUILT then
    local bottom = {}
    local top = {}
    for i = 0, segments - 1 do
        local angle = (i / segments) * 2 * math.pi
        local x = math.cos(angle) * radius
        local z = math.sin(angle) * radius
        bottom[i] = {x, 0, z}
        top[i] = {x, height, z}
    end

    local stemColour = {58, 122, 42, 255}

    for i = 0, segments - 1 do
        local ni = (i + 1) % segments
        local b0, b1, t0, t1 = bottom[i], bottom[ni], top[i], top[ni]

        local n1 = faceNormal(b0, t0, b1)
        addVertexes({
            Vertex{posn = b0, colour = stemColour, normal = n1},
            Vertex{posn = t0, colour = stemColour, normal = n1},
            Vertex{posn = b1, colour = stemColour, normal = n1},
        })

        local n2 = faceNormal(b1, t0, t1)
        addVertexes({
            Vertex{posn = b1, colour = stemColour, normal = n2},
            Vertex{posn = t0, colour = stemColour, normal = n2},
            Vertex{posn = t1, colour = stemColour, normal = n2},
        })
    end

    -- Cap the top of the tube so it's a solid surface rather than a hole the
    -- flower appears to float above.
    local center = {0, height, 0}
    for i = 0, segments - 1 do
        local ni = (i + 1) % segments
        local nCap = faceNormal(center, top[ni], top[i])
        addVertexes({
            Vertex{posn = center, colour = stemColour, normal = nCap},
            Vertex{posn = top[ni], colour = stemColour, normal = nCap},
            Vertex{posn = top[i], colour = stemColour, normal = nCap},
        })
    end

    STEM_BUILT = true
end

nodes.name: FlowerGeometry
nodes.coreScript:
local layers = 5
local petalsPerLayer = 6
local goldenAngle = 137.5 * math.pi / 180

local function faceNormal(a, b, c)
    local e1x, e1y, e1z = b[1] - a[1], b[2] - a[2], b[3] - a[3]
    local e2x, e2y, e2z = c[1] - a[1], c[2] - a[2], c[3] - a[3]
    local nx = e1y * e2z - e1z * e2y
    local ny = e1z * e2x - e1x * e2z
    local nz = e1x * e2y - e1y * e2x
    local len = math.sqrt(nx * nx + ny * ny + nz * nz)
    if len < 1e-8 then
        return {0, 1, 0}
    end
    return {nx / len, ny / len, nz / len}
end

if not FLOWER_BUILT then
    for layer = 0, layers - 1 do
        -- Innermost layer starts at radius 0 so the petals close up around a
        -- bud-like center instead of floating as a ring above the stem.
        local layerRadius = layer * 8
        local petalLength = 22 + layer * 5
        local petalWidth = 10 + layer * 3
        local curl = 10 - layer * 1.5
        local layerRotation = layer * goldenAngle

        local red = math.max(120, 210 - layer * 15)
        local petalColour = {red, 20 + layer * 5, 55 + layer * 5, 255}

        for p = 0, petalsPerLayer - 1 do
            local angle = layerRotation + p * (2 * math.pi / petalsPerLayer)
            local cosA = math.cos(angle)
            local sinA = math.sin(angle)

            local function toWorld(lx, ly, lz)
                local rx = lx * cosA - lz * sinA
                local rz = lx * sinA + lz * cosA
                return {rx + cosA * layerRadius, ly, rz + sinA * layerRadius}
            end

            local baseLeft = toWorld(0, 0, -petalWidth / 2)
            local baseRight = toWorld(0, 0, petalWidth / 2)
            local tipLeft = toWorld(petalLength, curl, -petalWidth / 4)
            local tipRight = toWorld(petalLength, curl, petalWidth / 4)

            local n1 = faceNormal(baseLeft, tipRight, baseRight)
            addVertexes({
                Vertex{posn = baseLeft, colour = petalColour, normal = n1},
                Vertex{posn = tipRight, colour = petalColour, normal = n1},
                Vertex{posn = baseRight, colour = petalColour, normal = n1},
            })

            local n2 = faceNormal(baseLeft, tipLeft, tipRight)
            addVertexes({
                Vertex{posn = baseLeft, colour = petalColour, normal = n2},
                Vertex{posn = tipLeft, colour = petalColour, normal = n2},
                Vertex{posn = tipRight, colour = petalColour, normal = n2},
            })
        end
    end

    FLOWER_BUILT = true
end
